1936, September
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOCK NO. 6.
Page 142 Cont.
Sep. 16 Patrick & Ed. Regan - Father & Son. .. fail to get along. The wife and mother non catholic - hardly realizes importance for them to pray .... Aunt & sister asks for prayers ....
20 Mrs. Anna Teeny - about 45 - (?) given up on July 3rd as hopeless ... liver cancer - was enrolled repetedly.
21 Mrs. Margaret G. Parker - 64 - of Pittsburgh - Presbiterian - luk- emia - cancer of white blood cells - has had 4 blood transfusions in 6 weeks - "about no hope." Enrolled To-day Page 143 Sep. 23 Lenard Orzechowski - 11 - threaten'd with operation on cancer on leg. 24 Mrs. Ron. McConachie (458 Eastlawn) 51 - adhesions ???? When only 12 - healthy and strong - a big girl - started to work in a dress making business. Admiring idea of corsetts she started to wear them .. Mother died six yrs. later and she had already at 18 begun to suffer from the former "tight lacing". Has had quite a few operations. Now starting a special novena ... asks ...
Peter J. Drexelious - 41 - hemoraging from bowels - has two daughters depending on him.
24 29 Richard Duncan - 47 - (presbiterian) Malte fever "given up absolutely" July 12th enrolled % weeping wife .. comes To-day able to walk alone and hopeful - now seems to have rhumatism all over body.
Leo Casey of Seattle - about 56 - Sarcomic leg. - has family of 5 to (Sup.) ... by brother.
Mrs. E. Bur of Ferndale - 70 - arthritis .... Drs. have no hope. Fr. Lambert ... Retreat ... To-night. Catherine Saunders .... Relatives' Arthritis
Page 144 Sep. 30
Dorothy Rahr - 10 - company ... with n.c. 39 Mich'1 Lucido - 19 - blood poison & pneu. in St. Mary's Hospital
